name: qBittorrent
tagline: Feature-rich BitTorrent client with a web interface.
description: qBittorrent is a free, open-source BitTorrent client with a clean web UI, ideal for managing downloads remotely from your NAS.
postInstall: Sign in as admin with the temporary password printed in its logs (Apps, then the app, then Logs).
Set your own password at once in Tools, Options, Web UI.
Downloads land in the Downloads folder.
